mappings.rationale: KBLI2020 code 39000 ('Aktivitas Remediasi dan Pengelolaan Limbah dan Sampah Lainnya' — a broad remediation/waste-management group) is disaggregated into THREE KBLI2025 codes, confirmed bidirectionally by BPS's own official crosswalk tables: Lampiran 5 (2020->2025, p.170) shows three consecutive rows all sourced from 39000 — target 39001 'Aktivitas Penangkapan Karbon', target 39002 'Aktivitas Penyimpanan Karbon', target 39009 'Aktivitas Remediasi dan Pengelolaan Limbah atau Sampah Lainnya'; Lampiran 10 (2025->2020, p.364) independently confirms the same three rows in reverse. This is not a title-similarity coincidence: the OSS relasi.json uraian for the 2025 parent kelompok 3900 explicitly lists 'penangkapan dan penyimpanan karbon' as just ONE bullet among many disparate activities the old 39000 code bundled together (soil/groundwater decontamination in-situ/ex-situ, industrial-site and nuclear-facility decontamination, surface-water pollution cleanup, oil-spill cleanup, asbestos/toxic-material abatement, landmine clearance, mining-site remediation, other specific pollution control, general site-remediation services). 39001's own 2025 uraian is narrow and technical (pre-combustion, post-combustion, oxy-fuel combustion capture, direct air capture, plus separation/compression/temporary storage of captured carbon before transport) and explicitly carves OUT natural carbon sequestration to a different code (02101) — the hallmark of a genuine scope-narrowing split, where a broad parent activity is carved into specialized technical service silos (capture / storage / everything-else-residual) rather than renamed in place.

payload.notes:
D1 crosswalk verdict: clean, well-evidenced SPLIT (39000 -> 39001/39002/39009), confirmed image-verified in both BPS crosswalk directions (Lampiran 5 p.170 and Lampiran 10 p.364, digits read directly off the rendered PNGs, not OCR). canonical.json's own status_mapping='MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE' undersells this — it is a genuine 3-way disaggregation of a broad parent code into narrower technical-service codes, not a simple match+extra-data merge; downstream consumers should treat 39000 as a SPLIT source, not a 1:1 ancestor of 39001 alone.

QUARANTINE REASON (why needs_quarantine=true despite high crosswalk confidence): the PP28-sourced per_skala licensing block actually attached to this 39001 ('Penangkapan Karbon'/capture) canonical record — Lampiran I.D p.1022, row 68, PP28 SK No.108013 C — is titled around 'Izin Eksplorasi Zona Target Injeksi Karbon' and 'Izin Operasi Penyimpanan Karbon', with ruang lingkup literally reading 'Wilayah Izin Penyimpanan KARBON' (carbon STORAGE permit area). Both per_skala entries describe carbon-injection/storage licensing, not carbon-capture licensing — semantically this content reads as belonging to sibling code 39002 (Aktivitas Penyimpanan Karbon), not 39001. Two explanations are equally plausible from the evidence I have: (a) PP28's lampiran never split 39000's single row when BPS split the KBLI code, so the same PP28 block was deliberately mirrored onto both 39001 and 39002 canonical records (defensible given PP28 has no narrower row to cite); or (b) a D1/D2 pipeline misattribution that placed storage-specific licensing exclusively under the capture code. I did not read 39002's canonical.json (out of this task's scope/file set) so I cannot resolve which; flagging for a targeted D2 image-verified check comparing 39001's and 39002's per_skala blocks side by side. Separately, the pipeline correctly EXCLUDED the second PP28 hit found (Lampiran I.I p.406, row 88, sea/harbor pollution-control companies) from 39001's per_skala — that exclusion is semantically correct and needed no fix.

LICENSING_INHERITS reason: both PP28 evidence renders show the row header 'Kode KBLI: 39000' (pre-split 2020 numbering) inside a document whose own _source_relabeled note confirms is genuinely 'PP Nomor 28 Tahun 2025' (label was corrected 2026-06-27, content unchanged) — i.e. a 2025-dated regulation whose internal lampiran table was never updated to the new granular KBLI2025 codes for this group. That is exactly the KBLI-2020-vintage-content-inside-PP28 pattern the workflow flags for D2 row-level image verification.

reasons: Independently read both crosswalk PNGs (Lampiran 5 p.170 forward, Lampiran 10 p.364/label-350 reverse) and confirmed the identical 3-way SPLIT: 39000 -> 39001 (Aktivitas Penangkapan Karbon) / 39002 (Aktivitas Penyimpanan Karbon) / 39009 (Aktivitas Remediasi dan Pengelolaan Limbah atau Sampah Lainnya), bidirectionally, matching D1 exactly (row text transcribed matches D1's citations verbatim).

Sanity-checked oss/relasi.json (adjacent evidence, cheap to verify): kelompok 3900's 2025 uraian lists 'penangkapan dan penyimpanan karbon' as one bullet among many disparate legacy activities (soil/site decontamination, oil-spill cleanup, asbestos abatement, landmine clearance, mining remediation) -- confirms D1's 'broad parent carved into technical silos' rationale.

Independently read canonical.json per_skala: two entries, 'Izin Eksplorasi Zona Target Injeksi Karbon' and 'Izin Operasi Penyimpanan Karbon' -- both geological injection/storage licensing, semantically distinct from 39001's own uraian (industrial pre/post-combustion, oxy-fuel, direct-air capture). This independently reproduces D1's quarantine concern before I read D1's notes in detail.

Independently read both PP28 PNGs: p.1022 row 68 (kode 39000, SK No 108013 C, header I.D.1022) literally reads 'Eksplorasi zona target injeksi Karbon di Formasi Geologi (Wilayah Izin Penyimpanan Karbon)' -- storage/injection-flavored, matching D1's page-ref transcription exactly. p.406 row 88 (kode 39000, header I.I.406) reads 'Perusahaan Penanggulangan Pencemaran di Perairan dan Pelabuhan' -- correctly excluded by the pipeline, no semantic link to carbon capture, matching D1's assessment.

Both PP28 renders show 'Kode KBLI 39000' (pre-split 2020 numbering) inside documents D1 correctly identifies as nominally PP28/2025 -- supports licensing_inherits=true and the 'PP28 lampiran never caught up to the granular 2025 split' explanation.

One caveat noted but NOT treated as refutation: D1's notes prose ties both per_skala permit titles to the single p.1022/row-68 citation, but only the first title is visible on that page -- the second ('Izin Operasi Penyimpanan Karbon') is not shown in either of the two provided PP28 images. This is a minor citation-precision gap, not a hallucination, and D1 already discloses the underlying uncertainty explicitly and recommends a targeted D2 check rather than asserting resolution.

No divergence found between my blind independent re-derivation and D1's proposal on the crosswalk mapping, the licensing-inheritance conclusion, or the justification for needs_quarantine=true; the proposal's own quarantine flag is itself correct and should be preserved pending the D2 39001-vs-39002 per_skala side-by-side comparison D1 recommends.
